_provenance.note: A forced non-zero exit cannot be recorded from a successful API call — hand-authored to exercise runJson's non-zero-exit throw path (exec.mjs:31-32), which github.mjs#prReviews catches and normalizes to null. `null` (uncomputable) must never collapse to a fabricated `[]`: the L6 brain-writes-reviewed gate distinguishes 'nobody approved' from 'could not fetch the reviews', and cold-boot's priorVerdicts load does the same for the verdict thread.
